policy: Nuclear data may be tracked in Git only when the file is small (at most 1 MiB) and its provider allows redistribution. Each file names its provider, source, terms with the evidence for them, the credit owed and its SHA-256. Larger data is fetched by hash.

files.content: ENDF/B-VII.1 H-1 neutron evaluation at 294 K in the OpenMC HDF5 format; the Windows native spike's only data fixture (docs/notes/WINDOWS_NATIVE_SPIKE.md)
files.provider: National Nuclear Data Center, Brookhaven National Laboratory (ENDF/B-VII.1, CSEWG); HDF5 conversion by the OpenMC project
files.terms: ENDF/B evaluations are released without restriction on distribution; credit the library and the issuing data centre
files.terms_evidence: NNDC release notice for ENDF/B-VI Release 3 (https://rsicc.ornl.gov/endf/release3.html): released with no restrictions on distribution; IAEA-NDS-0200 (https://nds.iaea.org/publications/iaea-nds/iaea-nds-0200.pdf): credit the author and the issuing data centre. The ENDF/B-VII.1 page itself states no terms (checked 2026-10-14).
files.attribution: M.B. Chadwick et al., ENDF/B-VII.1 Nuclear Data for Science and Technology, Nuclear Data Sheets 112 (2011) 2887; distributed by the NNDC, Brookhaven National Laboratory
